Vary the emotional tone—ranging from fear and outrage to excitement and intrigue—and avoid overly fantastical claims that seem entirely implausible. Include subtle variations in format, such as listicles ('Top 5 Secrets'), quizzes, or direct challenges to the reader, to reflect the wide range of clickbait styles encountered online.
